title: PwC sells advice on using AI responsibly. Its own reports were written by a careless one.
excerpt: The world’s biggest consultancies are selling companies expensive advice on how to adopt AI without getting burned. Their own reports keep getting burned. PwC is the latest to be caught. content_html:
The world’s biggest consultancies are selling companies expensive advice on how to adopt AI without getting burned. Their own reports keep getting burned.

PwC is the latest to be caught. Four of its Middle East “thought leadership” reports were a mess, the Financial Times reported. The reports, on AI and electric vehicles, carried fake footnotes, misattributed claims and made-up sources. The research group GPTZero flagged the errors as AI hallucinations, and the FT verified them.

A footnote that ended in ‘chatgpt.com’

The giveaways were not subtle. One report cited a PwC survey claiming 70% of Middle East chief executives expect generative AI to reshape their business. The footnote linked to a news article that never mentioned the survey. Another footnote’s web address still carried the tag “utm_source=chatgpt.com.”

“The chaotic signposting of source material is symptomatic of AI-generated research,” GPTZero’s Paul Esau told the FT. This is a firm that markets itself as an adviser on using AI responsibly, including how to avoid exactly these errors.

PwC is not alone. It completes an unwanted set. GPTZero’s earlier work pushed KPMG to pull an October report. It had made false claims about AI use at UBS, the UK’s NHS and Transport for London. EY retracted a study last month over fake footnotes. Deloitte has twice slipped AI fabrications into government reports, including a $1.6m health plan in Canada that cited papers which do not exist.

The pattern repeats each time. The Big Four have pumped out hundreds of AI thought-leadership pieces to win clients, while pushing their own staff to use AI to work faster. The result is AI slop with a blue-chip logo on it.

Do as we say

The timing is almost too neat. The same week, PwC’s US chief executive Paul Griggs was telling Business Insider where companies go wrong with AI. One trap he named was bolting it onto broken processes.

“All AI is going to do for you is tell you how bad your messy process really is,” Griggs said. His own firm just proved him right.

Marking their own homework

The awkward part is what it says about the product. These firms charge premium rates for judgment and rigour. Yet no one appears to have checked whether the sources were real. It is the same gap that lets AI-written code ship with security holes: the output looks right, so nobody looks closer.

It also cuts against the sales pitch. Consultants are among the loudest voices telling clients AI will transform their work. Their own reports show how it can quietly corrupt it, and how the hype outruns the safe use. The hallucinations are the tell, and a detector keeps finding them. The firms keep publishing anyway.

content_html_zh:
世界上最大的咨询公司正在向企业提供昂贵的建议，告诉他们如何在不被烧毁的情况下采用人工智能。 他们自己的报告不断被烧毁。

普华永道是最新一个被抓的。 据英国《金融时报》报道，其四份中东“思想领导力”报告一团糟。 这些关于人工智能和电动汽车的报告带有虚假脚注、错误的说法和捏造的消息来源。 研究小组 GPTZero 将这些错误标记为人工智能幻觉，英国《金融时报》也对此进行了验证。

以“chatgpt.com”结尾的脚注

这些赠品并不微妙。 一份报告援引普华永道的一项调查，称 70% 的中东首席执行官预计生成式人工智能将重塑他们的业务。 脚注链接到一篇从未提及该调查的新闻文章。 另一个脚注的网址仍然带有标签“utm_source=chatgpt.com”。

GPTZero 的 Paul Esau 告诉英国《金融时报》：“源材料的混乱路标是人工智能生成的研究的症状。” 这家公司将自己定位为负责任地使用人工智能的顾问，包括如何避免这些错误。

现在四个人都

来自欧盟科技界的最新传言、我们明智的创始人鲍里斯的故事，以及一些值得怀疑的人工智能艺术。 每周都会免费发送到您的收件箱中。 立即注册！

普华永道并不孤单。 它完成了不需要的集合。 GPTZero 的早期工作促使毕马威 (KPMG) 撤回了 10 月份的报告。 它对瑞银集团、英国国民医疗服务体系和伦敦交通局使用人工智能做出了虚假声明。 安永上个月撤回了一项关于虚假脚注的研究。 德勤曾两次将人工智能捏造的内容纳入政府报告，其中包括加拿大一项价值 160 万美元的健康计划，该计划引用了不存在的论文。

该模式每次都会重复。 四大巨头已经推出了数百个人工智能思想领导力作品来赢得客户，同时推动自己的员工使用人工智能来加快工作速度。 结果是带有蓝筹标志的 AI slop。

按我们说的做

时机几乎太整齐了。 同一周，普华永道美国首席执行官保罗·格里格斯 (Paul Griggs) 告诉《商业内幕》，企业在人工智能方面存在哪些问题。 他所说的一个陷阱是将其固定在损坏的流程上。

“人工智能能为你做的就是告诉你，你的混乱过程到底有多糟糕，”格里格斯说。 他自己的公司刚刚证明他是对的。

标记自己的作业

尴尬的部分是它对产品的描述。 这些公司对判断力和严谨性收取高额费用。 然而似乎没有人检查过消息来源是否真实。 正是同样的差距让人工智能编写的代码带有安全漏洞：输出看起来正确，所以没有人仔细观察。

它还削弱了销售宣传。 顾问们是最响亮地告诉客户人工智能将改变他们的工作的人之一。 他们自己的报告显示了它如何悄悄地破坏它，以及炒作如何超过安全使用。 幻觉就是线索，探测器不断发现它们。 无论如何，这些公司仍在继续发布。
